placement: Core (guardrail) — implements CA-0003, approved by the owner on 2026-09-30 (kemiller2002/limen#19): records the decision, then tools/contract-gen gains two typescript-codec target options, roots (emit only the decoders reachable from those types, plus the codec runtime) and shared (import the runtime and those decoders from another codec module and re-export them instead of emitting them). contract/targets.json adds src/generated/core.handshake.codec.ts (roots: EngineHandshake) and has core.codec.ts share it, so no decoder is emitted twice. src/kernel/handshake.ts imports the handshake codec; architecture/core.json lists the new generated public Core file. The ./contract subpath and every exported name of core.codec.ts are unchanged.
